What Are You Really Paying For SanDisk's AI Flash Boom?
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) stock has risen nearly 1,700% over the past year, even after falling 18% over the past three months to about 24% below its 52-week high. At a price near $1,770, it trades at about 22.7 times trailing adjusted earnings. That is normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back. Analysts' forecast earnings are defined differently. On forecast earnings, it looks far cheaper, if those earnings last.
